mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, description, price, status, image_url, phone, create_time, update_time FROM product WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, user_id, title, description, price, status, image_url, phone, create_time, update_time FROM product WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id, title, description, price, status, image_url, phone, create_time, update_time FROM product WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (user_id, title, description, price, status, image_url, phone, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{price}, #{status}, #{imageUrl}, #{phone}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, status = #{status}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
